records.context: ``clear RAM`` Drops spaCR's own caches: the merged-microscope field of view LRU (:func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` — by far the largest, whole image stacks), the file-format and DB-format caches, the zoomed-animation cache, the icon and preview ``lru_cache``\ s, the filter-kind cache, every live :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` thumbnail LRU, and Qt's own ``QPixmapCache``. A process with no live Qt application also runs ``gc.collect()``. The GUI deliberately does not: walking a heap of live Qt wrappers can enter already-retired C++ objects and crash the process. It cannot return memory the allocator has decided to keep, and it says so when the measured RSS does not move.

records.source: ``clear RAM`` Drops spaCR's own caches: the merged-field LRU (:func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` — by far the largest, whole image stacks), the file-format and DB-format caches, the zoomed-animation cache, the icon and preview ``lru_cache``\ s, the filter-kind cache, every live :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` thumbnail LRU, and Qt's own ``QPixmapCache``. A process with no live Qt application also runs ``gc.collect()``. The GUI deliberately does not: walking a heap of live Qt wrappers can enter already-retired C++ objects and crash the process. It cannot return memory the allocator has decided to keep, and it says so when the measured RSS does not move.
records.translation: ``clear RAM`` Hreinsar skyndiminni spaCR sjálfs: LRU-skyndiminni sameinaðra myndsviða (:func:`spacr.crops.clear_field_cache` — langstærst, heilir myndastaflar), skyndiminni skráarsniða og DB-sniða, skyndiminni stækkaðra hreyfimynda, ``lru_cache``-skyndiminni fyrir tákn og forskoðanir, skyndiminni síugerða, hvert virkt LRU-smámyndaskyndiminni í :class:`~spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails` og ``QPixmapCache`` í Qt sjálfu. Ferli sem hefur ekkert virkt Qt-forrit keyrir einnig ``gc.collect()``. Myndræna notendaviðmótið (GUI) gerir það viljandi ekki: að ganga yfir hrúgu af lifandi Qt-hjúpum getur lent á C++ hlutum sem þegar hafa verið lagðir niður og látið ferlið hrynja. Það getur ekki skilað minni sem minnisúthlutarinn hefur ákveðið að halda, og segir frá því þegar mælt RSS breytist ekki.
